title: El Rey como Jefe del Estado y símbolo de unidad
goal: Comprender el papel constitucional del Rey como Jefe del Estado y diferenciar sus residencias institucionales.

items: Define the King's constitutional status under Title II (Article 56) as Head of State and symbol of unity and permanence.
Identify King Felipe VI as the current monarch since June 2014.
Distinguish between the Zarzuela Palace (official residence) and the Royal Palace (ceremonial state functions).
Use 'ostentar' and 'asumir' to describe high constitutional offices.
I can define the King's constitutional status under Title II (Article 56) as Head of State and symbol of unity and permanence.
I can identify King Felipe VI as the current monarch since June 2014.
I can distinguish between the Zarzuela Palace (official residence) and the Royal Palace (ceremonial state functions).
I can use 'ostentar' and 'asumir' to describe high constitutional offices.
